case1A.description: PEC sphere scattering with 6-directional anisotropic UPML (PEC-backed). lambda0 = 1 (k0 = 2*pi) for every set; k0R = 2*pi*R.

standard.description: k0R = pi (R = 0.5), core L = 2, tPML = 0.5, lc = lambda0/8

high_freq.description: Electrically larger sphere k0R = 1.5*pi (R = 0.75), core L = 2.5 (same 0.5 air gap), tPML = 0.5

thick_pml.description: As standard with a thick PML tPML = 0.75

thin_pml.description: As standard with a thin PML tPML = 0.25

case1B.description: High-permittivity sphere Mie scattering with anisotropic UPML. lambda0 = 1, R = 0.3 (k0R = 1.885), core L = 1.6, tPML = 0.5; sphere meshed at lambda0/sqrt(eps)/8.

mie_high_eps.suiteReason: v1.0 tier (2026-10-14, papers/paper2): at most 2 of the 11 standard combinations converge in the v1.0 records (M3 Pro)

mie_ultra_high_eps.description: eps_r = 25 (k0R*sqrt(eps) = 9.4) k0 raised by 1% (k0 = 6.3460): at k0 = 2*pi it sat on a cluster of nearly degenerate high-Q Mie modes (nearest < 0.01%); nearest mode now 0.86% away (resonance_check.py, 2026-09-28).
mie_ultra_high_eps.suiteReason: v1.0 tier (2026-10-14, papers/paper2): at most 2 of the 11 standard combinations converge in the v1.0 records (M3 Pro)

case1C.description: Aperture-coupled two-chamber scatterer (PEC septum with a w x w duct) with anisotropic UPML. Chambers Lc = 1.5, tPML = 0.5, lc = lambda0/8.

case2A.description: Empty PEC cavity 4 x 2 x 2 (mesh unchanged: lc = 0.1, PPW 7.6, 92k DOF)

standard.description: k0 = 2*pi, 0.8% from the (5,3,1) box mode k = 6.332 (near-resonant)

off_resonance.description: Same mesh as standard, k0 = 2.0: in the gap between the (1,1,0) mode (k = 1.756) and the (0,1,1) mode (k = 2.221)

case2B.description: Two 2x2x2 chambers coupled through a w x w iris in a PEC wall of thickness th (geometry fixed 2026-09-28: the chambers used to be disconnected). lc = 0.13.

off_resonance.description: Geometry of medium_iris, k0 = 4.15: gap between the single-chamber (2,1,1) mode (k = 3.85) and (2,2,0) mode (k = 4.44); k0 = 2*pi of the other sets is ~3% from the degenerate chamber-mode cluster at k = 6.49

case2C.description: Two 2x2x2 chambers coupled through a g x hSlit slit in a PEC plate; lcFar = 0.13, lcNear = g/2.

off_resonance.description: Geometry of medium_slit, k0 = 4.15 (same off-resonance gap as case2B)

case2D.description: Maze-like cavity 8 x 2 x 2 with Nwall internal PEC wall pairs (thickness 0.03), lc = 0.13

many_walls.description: Nwall = 20, opening 20% (lc = 0.145: the 40 wall slabs refine the mesh locally)

off_resonance.description: Geometry of few_walls, k0 = 2.09: gap between the empty-box (3,1,0) mode (k = 1.96) and (0,1,1)/(4,1,0) modes (k = 2.22); lower-confidence off-resonance point (dense axial spectrum of the Lx = 8 box)

case2E.description: Iris-loaded rectangular waveguide a x b x L = 1 x 0.5 x 10 (PEC PortIn, Silver-Mueller PortOut), lc = 0.13

case2F.description: TEAM Workshop Problem 19: waveguide-fed cylindrical cavity with dielectric rod (Bossavit, Lamaudiere, Maestrali, EdF 1992; https://www.compumag.org/jsite/images/stories/TEAM/problem19.pdf). Real millimeter geometry: 86.36x43.18mm waveguide feeding a 90mm-diameter cylindrical cavity through a 15mm iris, optional dielectric rod on the axis. lambda0 = wavelength at each loading's measured resonance (paper Fig. 5). Mesh unchanged (PPW ~7, lcRod = rodR/3). Since 2026-09-28 the rod gets its real permittivity epsLossy (it was left at eps_r = 1 before).

plex7.description: Plexiglas rod eps_r = 2.7 - 0.01i, diameter 7mm, f0 = 2490 MHz

plex9.description: Plexiglas rod eps_r = 2.7 - 0.01i, diameter 9mm, f0 = 2462 MHz

pvc7.description: PVC rod eps_r = 4.0 - 0.1i, diameter 7mm, f0 = 2482 MHz

pvc9.description: PVC rod eps_r = 4.0 - 0.1i, diameter 9mm, f0 = 2446 MHz

case3A.description: Two-layer PEC cavity 0.4^3 (lower half air, upper half eps = kappa). One common mesh for all sets, sized for kappa = 100. (freq_perturb_a/b removed: frequency probes of the old 2*lambda0 geometry.)

high_contrast.description: kappa = 100 Operating point moved off an accidental resonance (nearest mode 0.05% from k0 = 2*pi) to the center of the widest nearby mode gap: k0 = 6.23631 (-0.75%), nearest mode now 0.33% away (resonance_check.py, 2026-09-28).

case3B.description: Multilayer PEC cavity 1.2^3, Nlayer z-slabs cycling Air / PTFE (2.1) / Alumina (9.8); each layer meshed at lambda0/sqrt(eps)/8, capped by the layer thickness.

many_layers.description: Nlayer = 15 (layer thickness 0.08) Operating point moved off an accidental resonance (nearest mode 0.20% from k0 = 2*pi) to the center of the widest nearby mode gap: k0 = 6.24507 (-0.61%), nearest mode now 0.30% away (resonance_check.py, 2026-09-28).

case3C.description: 3D checkerboard of eps = 1 / 100 cells in a PEC cavity 0.32^3; Eps100 cells at lambda0/10/8 (in a checkerboard every Eps1 face touches Eps100, so the mesh is nearly uniformly fine).

coarse_check.description: Nc = 4 (cell 0.080 = 0.80 local wavelengths in Eps100) Operating point moved off an accidental resonance (nearest mode 0.02% from k0 = 2*pi) to the center of the widest nearby mode gap: k0 = 6.23316 (-0.80%), nearest mode now 0.82% away (resonance_check.py, 2026-09-28).

case3D.description: Array of eps = 50 rods (R = 0.032, pitch 0.08, height 0.16, margin 0.08; 0.16x scale of the original design) in a PEC box; rods at lambda0/sqrt(50)/8.

dense_array.description: 10 x 10 rods Operating point moved off an accidental resonance (nearest mode 0.01% from k0 = 2*pi) to the center of the widest nearby mode gap: k0 = 6.31553 (+0.51%), nearest mode now 0.40% away (resonance_check.py, 2026-09-28).

case3E.description: Lossy inclusion (0.8^3, eps = 10*(1 - i tan(delta))) in a 2^3 PEC cavity; one common graded mesh (inclusion lambda0/sqrt(10)/8, air lambda0/8).

case3F.description: Mosaic of 6^3 cells (Air / PTFE 2.1 / Alumina 9.8 / HighK kappa / Lossy 10*(1 - i tan(delta))) in a 0.32^3 PEC cavity; the first floor(vloss*216) cells are lossy. Common sizing for all sets (kappaMesh = 150, vlossMesh = 0.2).
